prerequisites: Basic knowledge of materials science and manufacturing technology at Bachelor level.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand and classify material properties, material design, and manufacturing technologies in their interaction.
Systematically evaluate material manufacturing processes and their processing under sustainability aspects and grasp the relationships between process, structure, and properties.
Analyze and compare manufacturing processes regarding efficiency, resource utilization, and environmental impact.
Apply modern manufacturing technologies such as laser material processing and additive manufacturing in a material-appropriate and application-oriented manner.
Professionally evaluate surface and material modifications for efficiency improvement, lifetime extension, and sustainability enhancement.
Assess material cycles, recycling strategies, and sustainable production systems, and estimate their potentials for industrial applications.
Think interdisciplinarily and integrate material, manufacturing, and system perspectives in the context of sustainability.
Structurally analyze complex engineering problems in the field of sustainable materials and manufacturing systems and develop solution approaches.
Critically reflect on ecological, economic, and social impacts of technical decisions.
Present comprehensible relationships from theory, exercise, and practice and communicate them professionally.

syllabus_topics: Manufacturing technology with a focus on sustainability and energy efficiency
Surface technology as an instrument for efficiency improvement and sustainability
Materials and sustainability: material cycles, resource efficiency, global challenges
Material testing, material processing, and sustainable material selection
Production of green steel and green aluminum
Characterization of recycled polymers (Exercise module choice)
